answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 31671 Country: United States of America Title: Haram Question: What should one do if they by mistakenly eaten haram without realizing? is it still sinful? does our dua get qubul? Answer ID: 31671 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 824/534/H=1432) What do you mean by haram? It should have been clear. However, such a person should perform taubah (repentance) sincerely. His sins shall be purged away if he is true in his taubah and there will remain nothing to hinder his dua to be accepted, in-sha-Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
